evidence_summary.birth_structure: Host error is born continuously through depth (born fraction 72% at layer 3 falling to 17% at layer 15) and propagates near-linearly with per-layer gain a_l ~ 1.03; the endpoint is ~83% accumulated propagation of mid-depth births.
evidence_summary.no_unit_structure: Top-1% units carry ~1.2% of error and cross-network unit persistence is ~0: the error is diffuse and network-specific.
evidence_summary.dominant_mechanism: In the native frame, born error correlates +0.335 (13/14 layer sign consistency) with the quartic residual star row RMS and +0.290 (13/14) with the t=24 Mehler row coupling, both clearing the preregistered 0.15/10-of-14 bar. Fourth-order pair structure and pair-series truncation pressure mark the birth sites.
evidence_summary.row_level: Row difficulty correlates +0.30 with dropped-CP4 mass, +0.31 with the t=24 coupling, and -0.30 with pairing_alpha.

proposal.name: additive pair-series tail extension t=25..30 on the unchanged Q24 state path
proposal.one_line: Keep the entire Q24 state recursion, dtypes, PSD repairs, star and CP handling byte-identical, and add only the t=25..30 Mehler slices - coefficients up to q=38 already exist in the table, rho powers extend by six elementwise multiplies per layer - into the same pair-moment contraction, refining exactly the object whose truncation pressure marks the error births.
proposal.mechanism: The t=24 row coupling measures the last kept term of the pair series; born error concentrates where it is large. Tail terms t>=25 are bounded by |rho|^t/t! with |rho|<=1 clipped, so the added terms are small, decaying, and additive: they cannot restructure the state or its conditioning.
proposal.material_difference_from_closed_q32: The closed fullbudget_k21_k4_closure_q32_fp32_pair_v1 candidate rebuilt the estimator to a full Q32 state with fp32 pair handling and failed numerically (LinAlgError and nonfinite means at connected resets). This proposal changes no state machinery, no dtype, no repair, and no normalization; it adds bounded decaying terms to an existing contraction on the stable Q24 state, with an explicit prelaunch stability probe.
proposal.implementation_sketch: In _q24_context extend the powers arena by six elementwise rho multiplies per layer (about 88e6 FLOPs total); widen _Q24_ORDER_GRID's consumed term axis for the pair einsums to t<=30; leave _univariate_edgeworth, _repair_covariance, stars, CP3/CP4, and all clips untouched.
proposal.cost_statement: The added cost is six of twenty-five extra term-slices in the pair einsums plus negligible elementwise powers. Admission requires a frozen source-structure estimate of the added FLOPs at most 60e9 against the roughly 66e9 headroom under 2^41 at the current 2.1317e12 native total; if the estimate exceeds it, the frozen fallback scope is t=25..27 only. No cap raise, no rank change.
proposal.gates_required: Its own node must freeze: a target-free stability probe (finite rollouts, unchanged blow-up census on the 11 repaired tails) before any target read; end-to-end evaluation only (host change followed by the established J tape regeneration and refit, judged on raw final MSE, never component accuracy, per the measurement-frame and partial-fix laws); and strict conjunctive accuracy gates with no retune.
proposal.law_conformance: No cap-ladder violation (no rank or cap change); co-adaptation honored by mandatory J refit on the new host tape; partial-fix law honored by end-to-end gating; reproduce-first honored by binding the Q32 negative receipt and differing materially from it.

explicitly_not_proposed: a full Q32 or higher state rebuild (closed, numerical failure)
unit- or layer-targeted patches (no unit structure exists; born structure is diffuse)
